blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Production deployments often use different models to balance cost and quality through cascading, routing, and switching models during long conversations. Context accumulates across turns. Each switch requires the target to repeat prefill over this context. Existing methods transfer full-attention (FA) K/V caches across models. Hybrid linear-attention models also retain recurrent states (REC) and convolution histories (Conv). The interaction between Conv and REC complicates cross-model state transfer. Conv perturbations can change keys and values in recurrent layers and alter REC updates. Conv histories are overwritten, but changes in REC can still affect later outputs. More accurate REC reconstruction need not improve continuation. Building on this, we propose Hybrid State Transfer (HST) for all three state types. It uses structured REC maps and preserves history order during Conv alignment. We calibrate the adapters using the frozen target's outputs during continuation. FA cache map updates are merged offline. Across five benchmarks, Qwen3.5 4B$\rightarrow$27B and 9B$\rightarrow$27B achieve mean task retentions of 89.88% and 94.11%, respectively. With source caches already available, separate timing on synthetic 16K inputs yields handoff body speedups of $21.66\times$ and $21.91\times$.
blocks.zh: 生产部署经常使用不同的模型,在长对话中通过串联,路由和切换模型来平衡成本和质量. 环境会相互累积。 每个切换需要目标在此上下文上重复预填. 现有方法将全心全意(FA)K/V缓存跨模型传输. 混合线性留念模型也保留了重复状态(REC)和演化历史(Conv). Conv和REC之间的互动使跨型态转移复杂化. Conv扰动可以在经常层中改变键和值,并改变REC的更新. Convolution历史被覆盖,但REC的变化仍然可能影响以后的产出. 更准确地说,区域经济共同体的重建不需要改进连续性。 在此基础上,我们提议对所有三种国家类型实行混合国家转让。 它使用结构化的REC地图,并在Conv对齐期间维护历史秩序. 在继续期间,我们利用被冻结的目标的输出来校准适配器。 FA缓存地图更新合并下线. 在5个基准中,Quen3.5 4B美元=27B和9B美元=27B的平均任务保留率分别为89.88%和94.11%。 由于已有源缓存,在合成的16K输入器上单独计时产生交接机身速度21.66美元和21.91美元.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Production deployments often use models of different sizes within a family to balance cost and quality through cascading, routing, and switching models during long conversations ( Heo et al., 2026 ; Ong et al., 2025 ) .
The source model may already have processed the context.
In this case, target prefill repeats computation over the same tokens to build the target’s inference state.
The cost of this repeated computation increases with context length.
Cross-model state transfer aims to reuse the source model’s computation by converting the source state into a form usable by the target.
Hybrid linear-attention models also retain recurrent states (REC) and convolution histories (Conv).
The interaction between Conv and REC complicates cross-model state transfer.
blocks.zh:
生产部署经常使用一个家庭内不同大小的模型,通过串联,路由,以及长对话中的切换模型来平衡成本和质量(Heo等人,2026年;Ong等人,2025年).
源模型可能已经处理过上下文.
在这种情况下,目标预填会重复在相同的符号上进行计算,以构建目标推断状态.
这种反复计算的成本随着上下文长度的增加而增加.
跨型态转移旨在通过将源态转换成目标可使用的形式来重复源模式的计算.
混合线性留念模型也保留了重复状态(REC)和演化历史(Conv).
Conv和REC之间的互动使跨型态转移复杂化.

blocks.en:
Existing work on cross-model state transfer focuses on the K/V caches of full-attention (FA) models.
Affine mappings fitted in closed form convert these caches across models ( Heo et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) .
Nonlinear correction modules are added to an affine K/V mapping and trained through a frozen target model using continuation cross-entropy and forward KL losses ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
The hybrid linear-attention models studied here also use REC to summarize history and Conv to store projected features within a finite window ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Source and target models may differ in layer layout, recurrent head count, and convolution channel count.
Conv also affects key and value computation in recurrent layers, and these signals drive REC updates.
Errors in Conv conversion can therefore propagate into REC and affect subsequent target computation.
blocks.zh:
现有的跨模式状态转移工作侧重于全心(FA)模式的K/V缓存.
安装在封闭式上的芳香图案将这些缓存转换为跨模型(Heo等人,2026年;Qu等人,2026年)。
非线性校正模块被加入到affine K/V映射中,并通过一个冷冻的目标模型进行训练,使用连续的交叉穿透和前进的KL损失(Quu等人,2026年).
此处研究的混合线性注意模型还利用REC来总结历史,并将预测的特征存储在一个有限的窗口中(Yang等人,2025年)。
源与目标模型在图层布局,经常头数,以及演化通道计数等方面可能有所不同.
Conv也会影响经常层中的密钥和值计算,这些信号驱动REC更新.
因此,Conv转换中的错误可以传播到REC,并影响随后的目标计算.

blocks.en:
Our controlled interventions show that the effects of Conv perturbations can persist in REC and alter later outputs after the affected history slots have been overwritten.
REC reconstruction controls further show that lower local error need not improve full-model continuation.
These observations motivate continuation compatibility : the target must be able to use the transferred context and update its state effectively.
We propose Hybrid State Transfer (HST), a framework for transferring FA K/V caches, REC, and Conv between hybrid linear-attention models.
HST combines structural adaptation with functional calibration through the target model and keeps both models’ pretrained weights fixed.
It uses pair-specific REC mappings with optional state-conditioned corrections and affine Conv alignment that preserves history order.
For FA, learned weight updates are merged offline into the base affine maps.
All states and position metadata are installed at a consistent boundary.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed HST framework using models from the Qwen3.5 family ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) on five benchmarks covering commonsense reasoning, knowledge-based question answering, and mathematical reasoning.
For 4B → \rightarrow 27B and 9B → \rightarrow 27B, mean task retention reaches 89.88% and 94.11%, exceeding the strongest compared hybrid baseline by 3.56 and 7.10 percentage points, respectively.
Supplementary 4B ↔ \leftrightarrow 9B experiments examine handoff with matching state layouts.
Separate timing measurements on synthetic 16K inputs with source caches already available show handoff body speedups of 21.66 × 21.66\times and 21.91 × 21.91\times for the two main directions, respectively.
These measurements exclude source prefill, the target model’s output projection from hidden states to vocabulary scores, and answer generation.

4B = 右倾27B 和 9B = 右倾27B ,平均任务保留率达到89.88%和94.11%,分别比混合动力基准高3.56和7.10个百分点。

这些测量排除了源预填,目标模型的输出投影从隐藏状态到词汇分数,以及答案生成.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are: • Conv and REC during continuation. In controlled interventions, the effects of Conv perturbations can persist in REC and alter later outputs beyond the convolution window.
Separate reconstruction diagnostics show lower REC reconstruction error alongside higher continuation KL. • Hybrid State Transfer (HST). HST transfers FA K/V caches, REC, and Conv with position metadata at a common prefix boundary.
It uses pair-specific REC maps with optional state-conditioned corrections and preserves history order during affine Conv alignment.
REC mappings and FA cache maps are calibrated offline through a frozen target model, and learned updates to the FA cache maps are merged into the base affine maps before deployment. • Task performance and handoff latency. Across five benchmarks, HST achieves higher mean task retention than the evaluated hybrid baselines for both 4B → \rightarrow 27B and 9B → \rightarrow 27B.
Separate timings on synthetic inputs with source caches already available show lower body latency for HST than for native target prefill.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Cross-Model selects supporting source layers and fits separate affine ridge maps for K and V. It removes source RoPE before K conversion and applies target RoPE afterward ( Heo et al., 2026 ) . CacheBridge constrains source-head support and weights fitting by attention sensitivity while retaining affine deployment ( Qu et al., 2026 ) . These approaches provide mappings for explicit full-attention caches. Additional persistent states require their own representations and correspondences.
blocks.zh: Cross-Model选择支持源层,并适合K和V的独立的afzine脊图. 它在K转换前移除源 RoPE,并在之后应用目标RoPE(Heo等人,2026年). CacheBridge在保留affine部署的同时,限制源头支持和受注意力敏感性制约的重量(Qu等人,2026年)。 这些办法为明确的全心全意缓存提供了绘图。 其他长期存在的国家需要自己的陈述和信函。

blocks.en: CacheLink adds nonlinear K/V corrections to a Ridge base and trains them through a frozen receiver using continuation cross-entropy and forward KL ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) . Receiver-side supervision and the distinction between reconstruction and downstream utility therefore have precedents. We examine continuation when recurrent memory and convolution histories also participate, and study full-attention cache calibration that can be folded into affine maps. The Ridge, CacheBridge, and CacheLink comparisons in Section 5 use hybrid extensions implemented for this study.
blocks.zh: CacheLink在Ridge基地增加了非线性K/V校正,并通过一个冷冻的接收器对其进行训练,使用连续的横贯和前进的KL(Quu等人,2026年). 因此,接收方的监督以及重建和下游公用事业之间的区别有先例。 在反复出现的记忆和演化历史也参与的时候,我们研究续作,并研究可折叠成近缘图的全心存缓存校准。 第5节中的Ridge,CacheBridge和CacheLink比较使用为本研究实施的混合扩展.

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 3.1 Hybrid Linear-Attention Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 混合线性留守模式

blocks.en:
Linear attention admits recurrent computation with a fixed-size state ( Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ) .
Delta-rule formulations maintain a matrix memory and update it at each token ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
The Qwen3.5 models studied here interleave full-attention (FA) layers with Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
线性注意力接受以固定大小状态的反复计算(Katharopoulos等人,2020年).
德尔塔规则配体保持矩阵内存并在每个符号上更新(Yang等人,2024年).
这里研究的Quen3.5模型与Gated DeltaNet(GDN)层互换全心(FA)层(Quen Team,2026;Yang等人,2025).

blocks.en:
FA layers retain K/V caches indexed by token position, and the cache size grows with prefix length.
Each GDN layer retains a recurrent-state matrix (REC) and a convolution history (Conv).
REC summarizes previous updates, and Conv stores a finite window of projected input features in temporal order.
For a fixed model, REC and Conv sizes do not grow with prefix length.
Model pairs may differ in layer layout, recurrent head count, and convolution channel count.
blocks.zh:
FA层保留按符位索引的K/V缓存,缓存大小随前缀长度增长.
每个GDN层保留一个经常状态矩阵(REC)和一个演化历史(Conv).
REC总结了先前的更新,Conv按时间顺序存储了预测输入特性的有限窗口.
对于固定的模型,REC和Conv大小不会随着前缀长度的增大而增长.
型号配对在图层布局,经常头数,和演化通道计数等方面可能有所不同.

blocks.en:
At each recurrent step, a causal convolution combines the current projected features with Conv history to produce query, key, and value signals.
Separate input projections supply decay, write, and output gates.
The previous REC matrix and the current keys and values determine the REC update under the decay and write gates.
The query reads the updated matrix.
Normalization, output gating, and an output projection then produce the layer’s hidden representation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ) .
Conv therefore affects both the current readout and the information written into REC.
Effects written into REC can outlast Conv’s finite window.

blocks.en: 4.3 Functional Calibration and FA Folding
blocks.zh: 4.3 功能校准和折叠

blocks.en: Low reconstruction error does not ensure that the target will use a transferred state effectively. We therefore calibrate the adapters through target continuation in separate offline stages: updating REC mappings, training the 4B → \rightarrow 27B REC correction, and learning an FA weight increment. The target model’s pretrained parameters, including those used for recurrent state updates and the vocabulary output projection, remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 低重建错误不能保证目标会有效使用一个已转移状态. 因此,我们通过目标继续分离线阶段对适配器进行校准:更新REC绘图,培训4B →\右旋 27B REC校正,学习FA重量增量. 目标模型预先训练的参数,包括用于经常状态更新和词汇输出预测的参数,仍然固定不变.

Initial calibration uses KL between native and transferred output distributions, together with normalized REC reconstruction error. Later task-oriented calibration also uses natural-text continuations and candidate-level outputs, including candidate-distribution KL and a mean-squared error term on centered candidate scores. Support layers and the grouped mapping structure remain fixed. The two model pairs are calibrated separately.

We partition it into 256-dimensional blocks, sum the blocks with alternating negative and positive signs, divide by the square root of the block count, and apply LayerNorm without trainable affine parameters. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose a unified framework for cross-model state handoff in the Qwen3.5 hybrid model family to reduce repeated prefill when switching models. The framework combines structural adaptation of full-attention caches, recurrent states, and convolution histories with functional calibration through the target model, including foldable linear updates for attention-cache conversion. Across five benchmarks, 4B → \rightarrow 27B and 9B → \rightarrow 27B achieve mean task retentions of 89.88% and 94.11%, respectively. With source caches already available, the two directions achieve handoff body speedups of 21.66 × 21.66\times and 21.91 × 21.91\times , respectively, on synthetic 16K contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个在Quen3.5混合模型家族中跨模型状态交接的统一框架,以减少转换模型时重复的预填. 框架通过目标模型将全注意力缓存的结构调整,经常状态,以及演化历史与功能校准相结合,包括可折叠线性更新用于注意力卡切转换. 在五个基准中,4B = 右栏27B 和9B = 右栏27B 平均任务保留率分别为89.88%和94.11%。 在已有源缓存的情况下,两个方向分别实现了21.66×21.66\times和21.91×21.91\times在合成16K上下文上的交接车身速度.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We evaluate HST only within the Qwen3.5 family with Gated DeltaNet layers. Transfer to other linear-attention architectures, including
KDA ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and to MoE models remains untested. Our benchmarks also provide limited coverage of long-context understanding. Task quality and handoff body latency are measured on benchmarks and synthetic contexts, respectively. Joint evaluation on the same inputs and under consistent inference settings is needed to establish the quality–efficiency trade-off.

KDA(Zhang等人,2025年),对教育部模型仍未进行测试。 我们的基准也限制了对长文的理解。 任务质量和交接体间隔分别根据基准和合成情况进行衡量。 需要对同样的投入和一致的推论环境进行联合评价,以确定质量和效率的权衡。

blocks.en: D.1 Training Configuration

blocks.en: Experiments use two NVIDIA A800 GPUs with 80GB memory each. Evaluation uses batch size 1, BF16 model weights and FA caches, and FP32 REC states. Both pretrained backbones remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 实验使用两个NVIDIA A800 GPU,每个有80GB内存. 评价使用批量尺寸1,BF16型号重量和FA缓存,FP32 REC状态. 两个经过预先训练的骨干仍然固定。

blocks.en: The reported 4B → \rightarrow 27B base-fitting recipe uses 500 FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) sequences of 1024 tokens, with four ordered source supports per FA and REC target layer. Conv maps share parameters across the four history slots. Both the weights and biases of the REC maps are functionally calibrated offline. The 4B → \rightarrow 27B REC correction has rank at most 2 and uses a 256-dimensional state summary; 9B → \rightarrow 27B uses its calibrated REC map directly. Both directions use rank-4 FA increments merged into the cache-mapping weights before online handoff.
blocks.zh: 所报道的4B →\rightarrow 27B 基调配方使用500 FineWeb-Edu(Penedo等人,2024年)的序列为1024个令牌,每个FA和REC的目标层有4个订购源支持. Conv地图在四个历史档分享参数. REC地图的权重和偏差都按功能校准离线. 4B → 右转 27B REC 校正最多排在2位,使用256维的状态摘要;9B → 右转 27B 直接使用其校准的 REC 地图. 两个方向都使用等级-4FA递增法,在在线交接前合并到缓存映射权重中.

blocks.en: During the final FA stage, the REC and Conv maps and the conditional REC correction, when used, remain fixed. The 4B → \rightarrow 27B configuration uses frozen transfer-teacher supervision for the first eight gold-solution prediction positions of mathematical sequences and native-target supervision for the remaining 24. The 9B → \rightarrow 27B configuration uses native-target supervision at all 32 mathematical prediction positions. Each final FA stage uses 384 training units and 768 updates. We use a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} and evaluate the final checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 在最后FA阶段,REC和Conv地图以及REC有条件的校正在使用时仍然固定不变. 4B →\右旋 27B 配置在数学序列的前8个金溶度预测位置和其余24个土生目标监管上采用了冻结转移-教师监管. 9B ~\右旋 27B 配置在所有32 个数学预测位置上使用本土目标监督. 每个最终FA阶段都使用384个训练单元和768个更新. 我们用3×10×4 3×Times 10×4}的学习率来评估最后的检查站。

blocks.en: Appendix E Native Conv Restoration Diagnostic
blocks.zh: 附录E 土著契约恢复诊断

blocks.en: Native Qwen3.5-9B is evaluated on eight packed 1,024-token blocks from eleven source documents, at cuts 128 and 512. We average cuts within each block, then average blocks equally. Conv is zeroed at each cut. Each branch consumes the case’s 32 true continuation tokens. After measuring step 4, selected REC and/or Conv states are restored once from the native reference at that step; FA is not restored. A further control restores REC, Conv, and FA together. The script verifies bitwise-equal native logits and zero KL for all 16 × 28 = 448 16\times 28=448 measurements at steps 5–32. Thus, FA caches retaining earlier perturbations can affect subsequent computation after REC and Conv have been restored. These oracle interventions are separate from transfer benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 原生的Quen3.5-9B在11个来源文件的8个装有1 024个托肯的区块上,在128和512号区块上进行评估。 我们平均在每一区块内减少,然后平均减少。 每次切片时Conv为零. 每个分支消耗案件32个真正的续作符号. 在衡量步骤4之后,从该步骤的原生参考中恢复了选定的REC和/或Conv状态;FA不恢复。 进一步的控制使REC,Conv,和FA一起恢复. 脚本验证所有16×28 = 448 16\ times 28=448 测量步骤5–32上的位元均匀的本地对数和0 KL. 因此,保留较早扰动的FA缓存会影响REC和Conv恢复后的随后计算. 这些神谕干预与转移基准是分开的。
